name: Neer Dosa with Veg Curry
steps: For the neer dosa, set aside these quantities from the combined ingredient list: 280 g rice, 650 ml water, 4 g salt, 20 ml oil. Follow the next steps for this part of the meal.
Rinse rice and soak for 4 hours. Drain and blend very smooth with 200 ml fresh water.
Stir in remaining measured water and salt to make a thin milk-like batter. This neer dosa batter does not require fermentation.
Heat a well-seasoned tawa over medium-high heat and grease lightly. Stir the batter each time before pouring a thin layer across the pan, tilting to fill gaps.
Cover for 1–2 minutes until the top is set. Lift carefully without flipping, fold loosely and repeat; let each dosa cool briefly before stacking so they do not stick.

For the vegetable curry, set aside these quantities from the combined ingredient list: 180 g carrot, 160 g green beans, 160 g peas, 150 g capsicum, 120 g onion, 280 g tomato, 10 g ginger, 10 g garlic, 25 ml oil, 3 g cumin, 1 g turmeric powder, 5 g coriander powder, 1 g red chilli powder, 2 g garam masala, 5 g salt, 300 ml water, 12 g coriander. Follow the next steps for this part of the meal.
Peel and dice carrots, trim beans into short lengths and cube capsicum. Keep the vegetables similar in size.
Finely chop the onion, mince ginger and garlic, and chop or puree the tomatoes. Measure the spices before heating the pan.
Heat oil in a heavy pan over medium heat. Add cumin and let it sizzle, then cook onion for 7–9 minutes until golden at the edges.
Stir in ginger and garlic for 1 minute. Lower the heat and add turmeric, coriander powder and chilli powder, followed immediately by tomato.
Cook the tomato masala for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until it thickens and no longer smells raw. Add the measured water and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add carrots and beans first and simmer covered for 10 minutes; add peas and capsicum and cook another 7–8 minutes until all are tender.
Add salt and garam masala, taste and adjust the sauce with a splash of hot water if needed. Finish with chopped coriander and serve hot.
tips: Allow 4 hours rice soaking separately. Start the vegetable curry before cooking the dosas so both can be served warm.
passiveTime: Allow additional soaking, resting, chilling or fermentation as specified in the steps.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
